headline: India escalates Apple probe over alleged iOS 18 issues causing repair costs
summary: The investigation focuses on whether an iOS 18 update led to display and microphone problems, potentially making Apple liable for user repair expenses.
details: India has intensified its investigation into Apple, focusing on alleged issues stemming from an iOS 18 update. The probe seeks to determine if Apple should be held responsible for display and microphone malfunctions reported by users. These alleged defects have reportedly led to unexpected repair costs for affected device owners.

headline_marked: [[61% of US voters oppose AI data center construction]] due to environmental and community impact
headline: 61% of US voters oppose AI data center construction due to environmental and community impact
summary: A recent New York Times/Siena University poll reveals 61% of likely US voters oppose new AI data centers, primarily due to environmental concerns and local community impact. This comes as projections indicate massive energy consumption increases.
details: A recent poll by the New York Times and Siena University found that 61% of 1,503 likely US voters surveyed in early September oppose the construction of AI data centers. Only 14% strongly supported the idea, highlighting widespread public concern.

Opposition was particularly high among Kamala Harris voters (74%) and non-voters (67%), while Donald Trump voters were more evenly split (49% support, 45% oppose). This indicates a broad, though not uniform, sentiment across the political spectrum.

The primary reasons for opposition include environmental impact and water usage (32%), followed by impact on local communities (21%), and general distrust or dislike of AI (18%). A significant 56% of opponents supported limits on new data centers.

These public concerns coincide with projections that US AI data centers could become the world's fifth-largest natural gas consumer by 2035. Consumption is expected to grow by 15 billion cubic feet per day, potentially surpassing the combined usage of Germany and Japan.

Despite the strong opposition, AI and data centers ranked low on voters' lists of most important issues for midterm elections, registering less than one percent for most demographics. However, younger voters (18-29 group) showed slightly higher concern at three percent.
